reason: The hypothesis combines the oxide dispersion strengthening approach demonstrated in Al0.3CoCrFeMnNi (P47, P28, P26) with the edge-dislocation-controlled high-temperature strength mechanism established for refractory BCC HEAs (P9, P10, P12, P30, P36, P44) and applies this combination to a new alloy system (TiVNbTa) for a specific application (W/CuCrZr interlayer). None of the passages propose or test Y₂O₃ addition in TiVNbTa, nor do they link ODS to edge dislocation pinning at 1273 K in this context. The synthesis of these two distinct strengthening concepts into a single intervention for a previously unstudied alloy represents a non-trivial integration.
